description:
Fast, fully offline image description and an accessible overlay for windows NVDA cannot read. Everything runs on your own computer. Images are never sent to the internet.
NVDA+Alt+A: describe the current element
NVDA+Alt+W: describe the current window
NVDA+Alt+F: describe the whole screen
NVDA+Alt+D: describe the clipboard image
On a photo message in a chat app, or an image file in File Explorer, NVDA+Alt+A describes the photo itself.
Press twice for a detailed description in a window, where you can ask questions about the image.
NVDA+Alt+O: the overlay, a list of a window's texts and icons; Enter clicks an item
NVDA+Alt+G: automatic descriptions of images without a label, on or off
NVDA+Alt+B: names for buttons without a name, on or off
NVDA+Alt+N: give your own name to a button or overlay item
changelog:
* Photos in chats: NVDA+Alt+A on a photo message describes the photo itself, not the name and time around it.
* WinZapp (WhatsApp): photos are described without opening them for you. VisionMate gets each photo by itself, closes the viewer at once and deletes the copy WinZapp writes. A described message says what its photo shows when you reach it again.
* Unigram (Telegram): the full-size photo Unigram keeps is described, so small text is read clearly.
* Image viewers such as Photos: NVDA+Alt+W describes the photo file at full quality.
* File Explorer and the desktop: NVDA+Alt+A on an image file describes it without opening it.
* Automatic descriptions (NVDA+Alt+G) now also cover photo messages, image files in File Explorer and photos opened in an image viewer.
* Descriptions no longer get stuck repeating the same sentence.
* A What's new window appears when you install or update VisionMate.
